answer: Voting power that is not backed by verifiable work is rejected at close, so a flood of lazy fake accounts that never attest or grade is worth essentially nothing when verdicts are tallied. It is effective because voting power is weighted by verifiable work over time, so a fresh flood of accounts cannot manufacture a decisive vote. The practical upshot is that honesty is the only strategy that scales — a farm that tries to game the system pays for each identity it adds. Consider a zephyr as the anchor of the cost.
